study type: Experimental animal study (gene therapy trial) with long-term follow-up
exposure: Adeno-associated virus (AAV)-mediated gene therapy (AAVrh8 vector expressing feline beta-galactosidase)
Delivery via bilateral thalamic and deep cerebellar nuclei (DCN) injection
cohort: The participants were GM1 gangliosidosis (GM1) cats.
finding: AAV-mediated gene therapy significantly increased the lifespan of GM1 cats and corrected various neuropathological markers in the brain, with MRI and MRS serving as effective predictors of therapeutic efficacy and monitors of cellular events.
